response.sql:
WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.riskeval,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s
    ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM group_rates
)
SELECT
  AVG(gr.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark,
  AVG(gr.rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_above_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate;

assumptions.assumption: A group with a total duration of zero has an undefined rate and is excluded from the benchmark and above-benchmark results.
